test-set.name: file-size
test-set.description: Tests for the extension functions in the EXPath "file" package. The tests rely on being able to modify a “sandpit” folder. The sandpit element in the environment instructs the test driver to copy that folder to a “sandpit” directory in a temporary location and set the current working directory to that temporary location.

test-case.name: EXPath-file-size-001
test-case.description: Use file:size on a text file

modified.change: Allow the file to contain a BOM

test-case.name: EXPath-file-size-002
test-case.description: Use file:size on an empty file

modified.change: Allow the file to contain a BOM

test-case.name: EXPath-file-size-003
test-case.description: Use file:size on a binary file

test-case.name: EXPath-file-size-004
test-case.description: Use file:size on a nonexistent file

test-case.name: EXPath-file-size-006
test-case.description: Use file:size on a directory, recursive
test-case.test: file:delete("dir5", true()), file:create-dir("dir5/sub"), file:write-binary("dir5/a.bin", xs:base64Binary(xs:hexBinary("0001020304"))), file:write-binary("dir5/sub/b.bin", xs:base64Binary(xs:hexBinary("050607"))), file:size("dir5", true())

test-case.name: EXPath-file-size-007
test-case.description: Use file:size on a directory, non-recursive
test-case.test: file:delete("dir5", true()), file:create-dir("dir5"), file:write-binary("dir5/a.bin", xs:base64Binary(xs:hexBinary("0001020304"))), file:size("dir5", false())
